title: Seed fill for the depth comparison L in {2,3,4}: seeds 45, 46 added to A=3 L2, A=2 L2 and A=2 L4
purpose: Not a new hypothesis test. After the L = 3 addition (five seeds) the neighbouring cells were at three seeds (A = 3 L2; A = 2 L2, L4). Adding seeds 45 and 46 puts L2, L3 and L4 of both policies on five common seeds so that contrasts, the policy x depth interaction and SDs are computed on one seed set.

runs.pretrain: D2 seeds 45, 46 (d 384, L 2, 24k, 2,400 steps; shared by both policies)
runs.sft_eval_A2: A2K192 D2 and D4 seeds 45, 46 (D4 pretrain reused from the A = 3 root)

analysis_rule: Re-run tools/analyze_depth_l3.py: all row-level contrasts pair seeds 42-46; P-L3 verdicts recomputed under the frozen rules of config/depth_l3_series.json and any change from the three-seed verdicts is reported explicitly.
